question: ______ received the 'Global Goalkeeper' Award by Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation for Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, on 24 September 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• PM Narendra Modi__ was conferred the "Global Goalkeeper" award by the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation for the **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** launched by his government.
 
• Over 11 crore toilets were built in the country in the last five years, which is a record.
 
• The cleanliness campaign was launched by the Modi government during its first term on October 2, 2014.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The 2021 Global Goalkeeper Award:

 
 
• The Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation announced Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, former United Nations under-secretary-general and executive director of UN Women, as the winner of the 2021 Global Goalkeeper Award. 
 
• She is a South African politician. She was the** deputy president **of **South Africa **between **2005 - 2008.**
 
• She has been honored for fighting for gender equality and her continued advocacy to address the Covid-19 pandemic’s disproportionate impact on women and girls.
